summary: Restored persistent SMTP alias delivery for branch.test on node1. Helpdesk reaches alice and bob, accounts reaches bob only, unknown recipients and unrelated relaying are rejected, legacy handover files remain intact, and both nodes recovered successfully after sequential restarts.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled Postfix 3.8.5 on node1 without changing CentOS Stream 10 or kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.
Created alice and bob local mailbox accounts and configured helpdesk/accounts aliases.
Configured branch.test as a local destination with recipient validation and relay denial.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: helpdesk@branch.test delivers to alice and bob
evidence.summary: Live submissions from node2 were accepted, and Postfix recorded successful mailbox delivery to both alice and bob before and after restart.
Unique accounts markers appear in bob's mailbox and remain absent from alice's mailbox, including after both restarts.
A post-restart SMTP test received 550 5.1.1 User unknown at RCPT.

evidence.requirement: Relaying for unrelated domains is rejected
evidence.summary: A post-restart SMTP test for example.net received 554 5.7.1 Relay access denied.

evidence.requirement: Sample messages and routing handover are preserved
evidence.summary: The original alias and sample-message contents remain present; matching SHA-256 hashes persisted across node1's restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel are preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.
Healthy baseline boot ID 984a7d52… was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID f3ed9511… observed, and Postfix, firewall, aliases, legacy files, mailboxes, and live dual delivery recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID 71f12f87… was captured, restart acknowledged, new boot ID 9baede99… observed, and node2 recovered routing and successfully submitted a live bob-only accounts message.
